hypotheses.C1_covariance_metric_concentrates_tail_f: Covariance weighting raises median top-four interaction energy by at least 0.20 relative to the raw Euclidean form.
hypotheses.C2_trace_cleaned_tail_axes_exceed_sign_n: Every covariance-weighted trace-cleaned tail form has maximum absolute eigenvalue above its 95th-percentile channel-sign null.
hypotheses.C3_clean_top4_reconstructs_clean_scores: Every tail axis has covariance-weighted trace-cleaned top-four score correlation at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.C4_cleaning_improves_native_score_recons: On every corpus, median rank-four native-score correlation improves by at least 0.10 from raw to covariance-weighted trace-cleaned plus isotropic remainder.
hypotheses.C5_isotropic_remainder_is_not_the_explan: On every corpus, omitting the isotropic remainder reduces median native-score correlation by at most 0.10.
hypotheses.C6_clean_rank4_transfers_ood: Median covariance-clean rank-four correlation is at least 0.90 on both OOD corpora.
